318:t_000:18.en:
$$ナミ$$
「I'm not saying it's tasteless... but doesn't a white base look kind of weak?」

318:t_000:19.en:
$$宗介$$
「It's the color of the machine I used to pilot. It's not weak at all. It's good luck, too.」

318:t_000:21.en:
$$宗介$$
「Yes. Presumptuous as it is, I'll be calling this machine '$$アル$$ II'.」

318:t_000:24.en:
$$ナミ$$
「...This might be your first and last match, so I okayed the paint job, but as the owner, I'm vetoing that one.」

318:t_000:26.en:
$$ナミ$$
「Listen, $$宗介$$. You haven't forgotten that if you don't win tonight's match, you're fired on the spot, have you?」

318:t_000:27.en:
$$宗介$$
「No problem. That's what the test run is for.」

318:t_000:28.en:
$$ナミ$$
「...I wonder if he really gets it...」

318:t_000:29.en:
$$レモン$$
「You say that, but... you seem to think highly of him.」

318:t_000:30.en:
$$ナミ$$
「Well, I did have to give him credit for spotting our machine's characteristics in one go...」

318:t_000:31.en:
$$ナミ$$
「And besides... that guy's build... he has the distinctive muscles of an AS pilot. So...」

318:t_001:0.en:
$$ナミ$$
「That machine's mark...! Is that the $$オーガ一家$$ gang!?」

318:t_001:1.en:
$$ＡＳ乗り$$
「Putting in extra practice, aren't you, $$クロスボウ$$.」

318:t_001:4.en:
$$ＡＳ乗り$$
「But, y'know, it'd be a shame to see you lose miserably in front of a packed crowd.」

318:t_001:5.en:
$$ＡＳ乗り$$
「So we'll crush you here, where nobody's watching. That way tonight's match ends in a forfeit.」

318:t_001:6.en:
$$ナミ$$
「You killed $$リック$$, and you're still at this...!」

318:t_001:7.en:
$$レモン$$
「And three against one is cowardly!」

318:t_002:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'll use these guys as my practice partners.」

318:t_002:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「Though I doubt this much will even work as a warm-up.」

318:t_002:3.en:
$$ＡＴ乗り$$
「A nobody like $$クロスボウ$$ dares to look down on us!」

318:t_002:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$クロスボウ$$... crossbow... A good name.」

318:t_002:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「Though it's no match for the Great Crossbow.」

318:t_002:8.en:
$$ＡＳ乗り$$
「Know your place! We'll make you regret defying the $$オーガ一家$$!」

318:t_002:9.en:
$$ＡＳ乗り$$
「Go regret it in the next world, you amateur!」

318:t_002:12.en:
$$宗介$$
「If you mean to provoke me, follow my friend's example and come up with better lines.」

318:t_002:13.en:
$$宗介$$
「That guy would hit you with something so harsh it'd make simpletons like you erupt in one shot!」

318:t_003:1.en:
$$ナミ$$
「We did it...! We did it, $$宗介$$!」

318:t_003:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「No problem. The opponents' level was just too low.」

318:t_003:3.en:
$$ナミ$$
「Ha! Now it's the $$オーガ一家$$ who forfeit tonight's match!」

318:t_003:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then... on condition of lodging and three meals a day, I'd like you to keep employing me from now on.」

318:t_003:5.en:
$$ナミ$$
「Of course, okay. Glad to have you, $$宗介$$.」

318:t_003:6.en:
$$宗介$$
(Well, the first stage is cleared for now...)

318:t_003:7.en:
$$宗介$$
($c's whereabouts are unknown too. All I can do now is fight alone...)

318:t_100:0.en:
$$宗介$$
(No comrades... My machine is a Rk-91 on the verge of being scrap...)

318:t_100:1.en:
$$宗介$$
(But I'll do it... I'll avenge $$アル$$ and rescue $$千鳥$$...)

318:t_100:2.en:
$$宗介$$
(This battle is the first step toward that...!)

323:t_1:5.en:
$$カレン$$
「H-hey, $$キリコ$$... Why don't you say something?」

323:t_1:8.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Those who come here aren't turned away. Don't worry about the rest.」

323:t_1:10.en:
$n
「Well... I don't think $$キリコ$$ is angry or anything like that.」

323:t_1:11.en:
$n
「It's just... he can't express his feelings well, so that's all he can manage...」

323:t_1:13.en:
$$カレン$$
「Looks like you've decided to learn a little about a woman's heart.」

323:t_1:14.en:
$n
「Just in case, I got advice from Miss $$スズネ$$ on how to interact.」

323:t_1:15.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Not bad. Looks like your stop-being-the-quiet-type project is coming along.」

323:t_1:16.en:
$$カレン$$
「...And how do you two rate it?」

323:t_1:18.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I have nothing in particular to say.」

323:t_1:19.en:
$$カレン$$
「You two should try being a bit friendlier, too.」

323:t_1:20.en:
$n
「It's fine, $$カレン$$. $$ヒイロ$$ and $$トロワ$$ have a self of their own, so they aren't swayed by what people around them say.」

323:t_1:21.en:
$$カレン$$
「Then are you working hard at stopping being the quiet type because you care what people around you say, $n?」

323:t_1:23.en:
$n
「But the biggest reason is that I wanted to change myself.」

323:t_1:25.en:
$$カトル$$
「$$テイタニア$$... $n over there gave off a much more unapproachable air at first, too.」

323:t_1:26.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「But he gradually changed. ...Though they also say his flaws started to show.」

323:t_1:28.en:
$$デュオ$$
「We'll hear in due course what you were thinking when you left $$マーティアル$$.」

323:t_1:29.en:
$$デュオ$$
「But seeing you desperately try to save $$キリコ$$, I could tell you're different from when you were a human weapon.」

323:t_1:30.en:
$$カレン$$
「So you've changed too, $$テイタニア$$.」

323:t_1:31.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「I... was able to change too?」

323:t_1:32.en:
$$カレン$$
「A lot happened, but from now on we're comrades. Looking forward to working with you.」
